body.title: P0–P3 runtime + dogfood
body.problem: Builder loop exists but turn check/abandon, automation resume, HTTP context, related pack, episode side collections, audit/CI, and compass/timeline are missing — product stops at W-001.
body.objective: Ship remaining architecture through P3: turn ops + automation + HTTP context + related; themes/proposed-claims/compass/timeline; decisions/sources/attachments/probes/flows + basis; audit policy + CI; dogfood this repo under workstreams.
acceptanceCriteria: turn check recomputes facts without writing; turn abandon writes facts with status abandoned
open stamps treeDigest; refuses dirty unless --allow-dirty
GET /v1/context returns VerticalContext; client HTTP path works
automation events resume timeouts on context/open; close refuses blocked events
decisions/sources/attachments/probes/flows loadable; decision basis stamped on close when present
spec-ledger audit + policy/audit.json; CI runs verify + audit + test
proposed-claims dir + list; themes optional; dogfood turn under W-002

Episode side collections + decision basis
